title: find-callees
summary: Lists the resolved outgoing calls of one routine, plus the library-bound ones
intro: Read this when you want to know what a routine actually calls, resolved through the index rather than by reading its source. find-callees --qname Foo.Bar lists its outgoing calls; add --json for machine-readable output.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint find-callees --qname <Foo.Bar> --db PATH [--db LIBRARY | --library-db LIBRARY] [--json] (resolved outgoing calls of routine X; library-bound callees are marked library)

flags.name: --library-db
flags.summary: the library index to bind library-bound callees against at read time (a second --db does the same)

help: drag-lint find-callees --qname <Foo.Bar> --db PATH [--db LIBRARY | --library-db LIBRARY] [--json]   (resolved outgoing calls of routine X: one line per call SITE, so a target called N times repeats N times; distinct callees: callgraph --qname X --direction callees --depth 1)
library-bound callees follow, marked (library; --json rows carry external:true and via edge|oracle.
With no library open the text ends N external (library not open) for the calls one could bind.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > What This Routine Calls (callees)...
steps: Needs an index of the project
drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > What This Routine Calls (callees)...
Enter or confirm the routine; its resolved outgoing calls are listed
